methodology.purpose: historical factor study when company-level original filing timestamps are unavailable
methodology.availability_rule: treat the monthly revenue dataset as usable only after calendar day 15 of the following month
methodology.effective_trade_rule: start evaluation from the first TAIEX trading day after that conservative availability date
methodology.return_rule: D1/D3/D5/D10/D20 compare target close with the close immediately before the effective trading day
methodology.stock_price_rule: use unified provider priority: TWSE MI_INDEX, data_history_sma, legacy data_fubon
methodology.interpretation_warning: this is not a filing-day event study and must not be interpreted as immediate market reaction to an individual company filing
